description: If cuts A and B lie within epsilon of rational cuts at p and q, their product lies between the rational cuts at pq-E and pq+E, where E=epsilon times (absolute p plus absolute q) plus epsilon squared.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.cut_product_bracket (A B : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.Cut) (p q ε : ℚ)
  (hε : 0 < ε)
  (hA :
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (p - ε) ⊆ ↑A ∧
      ↑A ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (p + ε))
  (hB :
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (q - ε) ⊆ ↑B ∧
      ↑B ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (q + ε)) :
  have E := ε * (|p| + |q|) + ε ^ 2;
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (p * q - E) ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.cutMul ↑A ↑B ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.cutMul ↑A ↑B ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalLower (p * q + E)
